digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and plan-review close gate
propositions: When acceptance criteria no longer match the codebase reality, closing with --force-close or --ref to an old commit leaves inaccurate state in the ticket system and is not the legitimate remedy.
The correct path to close a ticket with invalidated acceptance criteria is to edit the ticket, re-pass plan review, and close against corrected criteria so the record remains accurate.

The completion verifier lacks an auditable criterion-disposition mechanism to distinguish completed, moot, invalidated-by-fix, and automation-owned criteria, forcing operators to misuse --force-close or historical refs.
The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check blocks closure of finished work when the criteria registry changes post-plan-review, forcing costly re-review of already-executed plans.
